newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government bonds close higher.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government bonds close higher.

text.p: Singapore government bonds closed higher in moderate trade on interbank and retail interest, dealers said on Thursday.
"Bond prices were marked up slightly again today following another fall in the interbank rate. Treasury bill yields were slightly lower. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.

Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$98.00/98.05 compared with Wednesday's close of S$97.98/98.03, September 2001 at S$96.95/97.00 against S$96.82/96.87 and June 2003 at S$94.95/95.00 from S$94.84/94.89.
